name: The sandbox, schematic
title: The sandbox, schematic
story: The factory sends a card into one throwaway pod: gVisor, non-root, read-only root, no service account token. A probe tries the internet, the host machine and the cloud metadata address, one after the other, each crossed out, and only named hosts are open. The model gateway then appears with the keys, then the card's budget meter: a call is held at its worst case, sent, and booked at its real cost. The pod holds a one-hour gateway identity, no push token and no model key. More calls fill the budget to its cap, the factory stops and a human decides: fund it or end it. At the end the factory ticks off its list one step at a time: kill the agent's processes, mint a write token, push once, revoke it, delete the pod. Only the element the caption names is bright; everything shown before settles to muted; the picture holds one second and fades out.
